Inside was a single sheet, folded tight. He worked it loose with a knife and read by lamplight: a child's handwriting, asking whoever found it to write back and say the sea was not empty. For forty years he had kept the light so others would not be alone on the water, yet no one had ever thanked him. He sat a long while. Then he took his own pen, wrote that the sea was not empty, sealed the note in the same bottle, and carried it down to the waves at dawn.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒。路灯把空荡的街道照成一条发白的河，偶尔有出租车驶过，带起一阵短促的风。早点铺的卷帘门半开，蒸汽从缝里钻出来，和清冷的空气缠在一起。清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面的声音格外清晰。远处高楼只亮着零星几盏灯，像还没合上的眼睛。天边泛起一线灰蓝，鸟还没有叫，整座城市在最安静的时刻，等着新一天慢慢到来。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a tiny bit, then asking a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n• It keeps shrinking the problem until it's so small the answer is obvious, like counting down to zero.\n• Think of standing between two mirrors: each reflection holds a smaller reflection, until they get too tiny to see."}
